english.title: Dishonestly make a false statement to obtain a benefit / advantage / payment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with a view to obtaining for

(A)_[yourself]_
(B)_[another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_

a benefit, advantage or other payment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BENEFIT / ADVANTAGE / PAYMENT ENTITLED TO..), under relevant social security legislation dishonestly made a statement or representation to

(C)_[the Department for Work and Pensions]_
(D)_[a local authority, namely **(.. SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..)]_

which was false, namely **(..SPECIFY THE STATEMENT OR REPRESENTATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 111A(1)(a) and (3) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992.

english.notes: This document applies to offences committed on or before 31st March 2026. For offences committed on 1st April 2026 or later, see H102683.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Seven years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
